intent: Choose exactly one option from a small visible set of radio buttons.
useWhen: Two to six mutually exclusive options that should stay visible
Settings where users compare options side by side
doNotUseWhen: Tabs for panel switching — use Tabs

requirements: Each radio has a unique value and visible label

doNot: Do not invent local Radio or RadioGroup
Do not use for tabbed content — use Tabs
snippet: <RadioGroup name="plan" legend="Billing plan" options={[{ value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' }, { value: 'annual', label: 'Annual' }]} />
